question: Who among the following personalities was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2020 for his/her contribution to contemporary dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhushan Lakandri**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhushan Lakandri:-**

 
 
• **He is an Indian film choreographer born on December 11. **
 
• He has done most of his work in Bollywood.
 
• He is not only a renowned choreographer but also an actor who has worked in Ramayana, a TV serial.
 
• He made his Bollywood debut as a choreographer in the film Ab Aayega Maza(1984). After that, he did many famous Bollywood films like Parinda(1989), Prem(1995), Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam(1999), The Blue Umbrella(2005), Saheb Biwi Aur Gangster(2011), and Naam(2022).
 
• Not only in Bollywood, but he has also choreographed many famous plays like Divine Radha and Ganga: A Dance Ballet starring Hema Malini as the main lead.
 
• **He was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2020 for his/her contribution to contemporary dance**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bickram Ghosh:-**

 
 
• **He is an Indian classical tabla player, film composer, and fusion artist. **
 
• He is the son and disciple of the illustrious tabla maestro Pandit Shankar Ghosh.
 
• Ghosh is widely considered to be one of India's most versatile artists, excelling in three musical fields simultaneously: Indian Classical, Fusion, and Film Scoring.
 
 
 
• **Sruti Bandopadhyay:-**
 
 
• **Sruti Bandopadhyay is a Bengali singer, composer, and songwriter. **
 
• She is the daughter of the renowned tabla player Bickram Ghosh and the granddaughter of the legendary tabla maestro Pandit Shankar Ghosh.
 
 
 
• Sumitra Guha:-
 
 
• **She is an Indian classical vocalist, known for her expertise in the Carnatic and Hindustani schools of classical music. **
 
• She is a Senior-Top grade artist of All India Radio and has received numerous awards and accolades, including the Padma Shri, India's fourth highest civilian award.
